verdict.rationale: Luma's own docs describe Luma Agents that run multi-step workflows across video, image, audio and text, and Luma Skills that let you "Build a Creative Workflow Once, Run It Forever." That points to reusable, agent-driven automation, but the only evidence is headline marketing lines with no detail on how it works. Missing for 10: documented background or unattended execution, recurring schedules or event triggers, completion notifications, setup and management docs for Skills, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
